mostWorthwhile.text: Following dissolved volatiles into volcanic plumes was most worthwhile: it explained how pressure loss releases existing material rather than creating hydrogen.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive cooling and crust combinations felt somewhat repetitive, especially when only one action was offered.

surprise.text: The fractured crust offering future routes for water was an interesting connection between the hot surface and what might follow.

arbitrary.text: Combining upwelling rock with open space to cool it was understandable, but the open-space ingredient felt somewhat abstract.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how water reaches and interacts with the fractured surface, although I hope for more meaningful choices.
